tool: Bash {"command": "mkdir -p /tmp/trace && cat > /tmp/trace/trace.py <<'EOF'\nimport ast, re, sys, glob, collections\nroot = \"/work/repo\"\nreq_text = open(f\"{root}/spec/spec/config-set-writeback/requirements.md\").read()\nreqs = []\ncur = None\nfor line in req_text.splitlines():\n    m = re.match(r\"### Requirement (\\d+):\", line)\n    if m: cur = m.group(1); continue\n    m = re.match(r\"(\\d+)\\. \", line)\n    if cur and m: reqs.append(f\"{cur}.{m.group(1)}\")\nfiles = sorted(glob.glob(f\"{root}/tests/writeback/test_*.py\") + glob.glob(f\"{root}/tests/test_set_*.py\") + [f\"{root}/tests/test_cli_set.py\"])\ncov = collections.defaultdict(list); uncited = []; total = 0\nidre = re.compile(r\"\\b(\\d{1,2}\\.\\d{1,2})\\b\")\nfor f in files:\n    tree = ast.parse(open(f).read())\n    for node in ast.walk(tree):\n        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name.startswith(\"test_\"):\n            total += 1\n            doc = ast.get_docstring(node) or \"\"\n            m = re.match(r\"\\s*Reqs?\\s+(.*?):\", doc, re.S)\n            ids = idre.findall(m.group(1)) if m else []\n            name = f\"{f[len(root)+1:]}::{node.name}\"\n            if not ids: uncited.append(name)\n            for i in ids:\n                cov[i].append(name)\nprint(f\"requirements: {len(reqs)}; set tests: {total}; files: {len(files)}\")\nmissing = [r for r in reqs if r not in cov]\nunknown = sorted(set(cov) - set(reqs))\nfor r in reqs: print(f\"  {r}: {len(cov.get(r, []))}\")\nprint(\"MISSING:\", missing)\nprint(\"UNKNOWN IDS cited:\", {u: cov[u] for u in unknown})\nprint(\"UNCITED TESTS:\", len(uncited)); [print(\"  \", u) for u in uncited]\nif \"-v\" in sys.argv:\n    for r in sys.argv[2:]: print(r, *cov.get(r, []), sep=\"\\n   \")\nEOF\ncd /work/repo && python3 /tmp/trace/trace.py", "description": "Write and run traceability script"}

As the plan says, `shell.py` and `loader.py` were not touched.\n- **Tests:** `tests/set_support.py` and all 10 planned `tests/test_set_*.py` modules exist. `tests/writeback/` has a test module for each writeback module.\n- **Small differences from the plan (none affect boundaries):**\n  - Planner tests are split into 5 files: `test_planner_{in_place,add,replace,merge,includes}.py`.\n  - Three extra test files: `tests/writeback/test_block_rewrite.py`, `tests/writeback/test_layout_values.py` and `tests/writeback/test_set_support.py`.\n  - `tests/test_cli_set.py` was added in 2ec52ed for task 4.5 but is not listed in the plan.\n  - `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock` were changed by c4f203f ("chore: add pytest-xdist"), which sits inside the feature's commit range. The plan says `pyproject.toml` is "not modified by this spec". It only adds a dev dependency.\n\n**2. Dependency direction**\nThe design requires writeback modules to import only modules to their left in this chain: value → compare → layout → edits → scalar_render → block_scalar → collection_render → target → planner → verify → leaf_diff → atomic → setter.\n- `value.py` (12-21): ruamel.yaml (`YAML`, error, nodes); config `errors`, `paths`, `scalars`.\n- `compare.py` (15-22): `constants.INCLUDE_PREFIX`, `model`, `paths`, `scalars`; writeback `value`.\n- `layout.py` (11-30): stdlib; `model`, `paths`. No writeback imports.\n- `edits.py` (10-16): `errors.WriteRefusedError`; writeback `layout`.\n- `scalar_render.py` (20-33): ruamel.yaml; `errors`, `model.ScalarStyle`, `paths`, `scalars`; writeback `value`.\n- `block_scalar.py` (17-27): stdlib `difflib`; `errors`, `model`; writeback `edits`, `layout`.\n- `collection_render.py` (17-23): `paths`; writeback `block_scalar`, `scalar_render`, `value`.\n- `target.py` (18-43): `errors.PathNotFoundError`, `model`, `paths`, `resolve` (`walk_path`, `PathWalk`, `WalkStop`); writeback `compare`, `value`.\n- `planner.py` (42-91): `errors`, `model`, `paths`; writeback `block_scalar`, `collection_render`, `compare`, `edits`, `layout`, `scalar_render`, `target`, `value`.\n- `verify.py` (13-21): `errors`, `loader.load_config`, `model`; writeback `compare`, `planner.FilePatch`, `target.SetRequest`.\n- `leaf_diff.py` (3-6): `history` (`LeafChange`, `SetChange`, `RemoveChange`), `model`, `resolve.flatten_leaves`; writeback `compare`.\n- `atomic.py` (11-18): stdlib `os`, `secrets`, `stat`, `contextlib`; `errors`, `model.SourceFile`.\n- `setter.py` (13-28): `errors`, `history`, `model`, `paths`, `theatre.Theatre`; writeback `atomic`, `compare`, `leaf_diff`, `planner`, `target`, `value`, `verify`.\n- `set_command.py` (15-28): `troupe.cli.shell` (`Handler`, `SubcommandRegistrar`, `TroupeArgumentParser`, `theatre_option_parent`); `paths`, `theatre.open_theatre`; writeback `setter`, `value`.\n\nFindings:\n- Every writeback-internal import points left.\n- No writeback module imports `troupe.cli.*`, and `set_command` does not import `troupe.cli.main`.\n- Every foundation name used is in the foundation's "Shared Seams" table (config-foundation `design.md`:91-99).\n- The only module outside writeback that imports writeback or `set_command` is `src/troupe/cli/main.py`:20, which the design expects.\n- **Spillover:** `git log a77a9be^..HEAD -- src/troupe/config/*.py src/troupe/cli/shell.py` shows no commits, so no foundation module was changed and no write-side logic leaked into it.\n\n**3. Every gate passes: full `uv run pytest -n auto` (1902 passed), `mypy --strict`, `ruff check` and `ruff format --check`. Nothing is committed, and I did not touch `planner.py` or `tasks.md`.\n\n**Decision for you:** your expected output for A1 doesn't match the contract. Requirement 10.2 says a changed paragraph is re-wrapped at the width of its old longest line. The old paragraph `Then check output.` is 18 characters, so `Then check the output.` comes out as `  Then check the\n  output.` rather than on one line. The tests check this wrapped output, and I noted the difference in `research.md`. If you really want the one-line result, the contract itself has to change.\n\n**How it works now** (`block_scalar.py`):\n- **Opaque units:** each run of consecutive old more-indented lines counts as one unit when old and new values are compared. If the new value holds that run unchanged and in the same order, its bytes are kept, and so are the separators around it when its neighbours are also kept and adjacent.\n- **What is still refused (exit 3):**\n  - any other new more-indented text (an edited, extended or added indented line);\n  - a more-indented line that would become the block's first line when the header has no indentation indicator, because YAML would read the indentation from that line.\n- **Separators:** next to a more-indented unit, YAML keeps the line break instead of folding it, so one fewer empty line is written there than between two paragraphs. Paragraphs next to a removed or changed unit get fresh separators.\n- **Pairing and width:** a changed paragraph is matched only with the old paragraphs in its gap, not with indented runs. The block-wide width used for brand-new paragraphs counts the more-indented lines.\n- **Safety net:** the write verifier still checks every write. Reorderings the matching can't keep (for example, swapping the paragraphs around an indented line) are refused with exit 3 rather than written wrong.\n\n**Results on your reproduction:**\n- **A1:** succeeds; the indented line and its surrounding bytes are kept, and only the last paragraph is rewritten (wrapped as above).\n- **A2:** gives exactly `doc: >-\n  Just run it.\nx: 1\n`.\n- **A4:** keeps both paragraphs' bytes and writes two empty lines between them.\n\n**Tests:** I replaced the two tests that pinned the old refusal.\n- Through the real CLI in `test_set_block_scalars.py`: A1, A2, A4, changes on both sides of a kept indented line, the CRLF version, and a refusal when the indented line itself is edited.\n- At unit level in `test_block_rewrite.py`, the same cases plus indented lines directly between paragraph lines, and four refusals: an edited indented line, an extended one, a new TAB line, and an indented first line without an indicator.\n\nAll expected outputs re-load to the intended value. Everything is committed on `main` (last commit `0291201`, working tree clean), nothing was pushed, and the final validation for config-set-writeback is **GO**.\n\n**Fresh checks on the final commit:** 1,902 tests pass, and `mypy --strict`, ruff lint and ruff format are clean. I also ran a real theatre with a comment, a YAML include and a CRLF text include through the CLI:\n- `show temperature` printed `0.2`.\n- `set model claude-sonnet` kept the comment at its column: `model: claude-sonnet # which model`.\n- Sets inside the included file changed only that file, and adding a key to its flow mapping gave `{tokens: 100, time: 30}`.\n- Replacing a whole include exited 3. An impossible path exited 5. `show` on a mapping exited 5. Each error named the file and the path.\n- `history agents.coder` listed the import events, then the two set events.\n- Afterwards `.troupe/` held only the user's files and `history.sqlite`.\n\n**How the run went:** each of the 32 tasks had its own implementer, independent reviewer, fresh checks and commit. Reviewers rejected and sent back five tasks:\n- **2.4:** a `<<` key would have been written in a form the loader rejects.\n- **2.5:** word-wrapping could break a line before a TAB, which changes the value.\n- **3.2 and 5.2:** two tests that couldn't fail.\n- **5.11:** one requirement mapped to the wrong test.\n\n**Final validation first came back NO-GO** on two contract violations, which I fixed, reviewed and committed before it passed:\n- **Folded values with indented lines:** any edit to a folded (`>`) value containing an indented line, such as a code sample, was refused. The contract only refuses edits that would *add* such a line. Unchanged indented lines are now kept byte for byte, and requirement 10.7 is amended to match.\n- **Quoting after a merge:** when a merge deleted a mapping's last entry, new keys copied that deleted entry's quoting. They now copy the last remaining entry, or use plain style when none remains.\n\n**Behaviours to know about:**\n- **VALUEs starting with `-`:** `-1e3`, `-.inf` and `-x` are accepted. This relies on overriding a private part of Python's argument parser, which a future Python release could break; the tests would catch it. A VALUE that looks like a long option, such as `--theatre`, must come after `--`.\n- **Wrapping:** a changed folded paragraph is re-wrapped at its old width. In the `$ troupe run` example, the last paragraph becomes `Then check the` / `output.` rather than one line, because the contract requires it.\n- **Merging into a mapping that comes wholly from an include** is refused with exit 3 (contract rule 4).\n- **Deleting a list item's compact first key** (`- name: a`) is refused with exit 3.\n- **VALUE parsing:** VALUE is parsed as YAML, so a real trailing newline in a shell argument is dropped. To get a newline, write it as an escape: `"bye\n"`.\n\n**Housekeeping and other changes:**\n- I added `pytest-xdist` as a dev dependency so the suite runs in about 55 seconds instead of about 3 minutes. Plain `uv run pytest` still works.\n- `spec/steering/structure.md` still says no code exists, and the `spec.json` files still say `tasks-generated`. Running `/method-command` would update them.

I also ran it serially (`uv run pytest -p no:xdist`): exit 0, 1902 passed in 182s. So adding xdist does not hide any test-order dependency.\n- **mypy:** `uv run mypy --strict .` exited 0 ("no issues found in 85 source files").\n- **ruff:** `uv run ruff check .` exited 0. `uv run ruff format --check .` exited 0 ("86 files already formatted").\n- **TBD/TODO grep: CLEAN.** Searched the foundation src files, `pyproject.toml`, all foundation test modules and `set_command.py`.\n- **Secrets grep: CLEAN.**\n- **Smoke boot: PASS.** `uv run troupe config --help` exited 0 from the repo root. Real `show` and `history` runs against temp theatres also worked (results below).\n\n### Contract probes (real CLI, repo root, temp theatres)\nThe test theatre had includes outside `.troupe/` (`file:../shared/agents.yaml` → nested `deep/d.yml`, plus a text include with CRLF and no final newline).\n\n**show, successful cases:**\n- Strings: `name`→`demo\n`, `flag: yes`→`yes\n`.\n- Booleans and null: `b`→`true\n`, `~`→`null\n`.\n- Numbers: `0o17`→`15\n`, `1e3`→`1000.0\n`, `.inf`→`inf\n`.\n- Folded `>` gives the bytes `a b\n`, with no `\x07`.\n- `list.1`→`2`, and the nested include `agents.sub.k`→`1`.\n- The text include prints `line1\r\nline2\n` byte for byte.\n\n**show, errors (stdout empty in every case):**\n- Exit 5:\n  - `show list` gives "is a list".\n  - `agents.missing` names the included file `../shared/agents.yaml` (10.4).\n  - `list.5` and `name.x` each name the file and the PATH.\n- Exit 2: `a..b`, a missing PATH, an unknown subcommand, a surplus argument, `--bogus`, and `show -x` (show/history behaviour unchanged by set's leading-dash parser).\n\n**history:**\n- 13 import lines with seq 1–13, in document order and with `old` null. `inf` appears as `".inf"`, folded as `"a b\n"`, and the empty mapping `{}` adds no leaf.\n- `history agents` keeps the original seq numbers 11 and 12. `history ag` prints nothing and exits 0.\n\n**Load errors (exit 4):**\n- When both files exist, the message names both.\n- A missing include target exits 4, names the target and the including file, and creates no `history.sqlite`.\n- An include cycle exits 4 and names the chain.\n- An anchor in a `.yaml` root exits 4.\n\n**Other:**\n- Leaving out `--theatre` makes the current directory the theatre.\n- Every user file hashed the same before and after. `.troupe/` held only `history.sqlite`, with no `-wal` or `-shm` file left behind.\n- After a hand edit, `show` printed the new value and `history` output was byte-identical to before (decision A).\n\n### INTEGRATION\n- **Cross-task contracts: OK.** None of the foundation files changed between `8fbd54c` (config-foundation marked complete) and HEAD: `src/troupe/config/{constants,errors,scalars,paths,model,locate,loader,resolve,history,store,theatre}.py`, `cli/shell.py`, `cli/render.py`, `tests/conftest.py` and `tests/support.py`. The only foundation-owned changes are:\n  - `src/troupe/cli/main.py:20`: import of `add_set_subparser`.\n  - `src/troupe/cli/main.py:76`: the one registrar entry in `SUBCOMMAND_REGISTRARS`.\n  - `tests/test_cli_usage.py:358-365`: the registration assertion now includes `set`.\n- **Shared state: OK.** `store` is the only module that touches `history.sqlite` (`store.py:76`, through `HISTORY_STORE_NAME` in `constants.py:24`). Downstream reaches the history only through `theatre.history.record_changes`, called in `writeback/setter.py:56`, which is a public seam.\n- **Boundary audit: OK.**\n  - `cli/shell.py:9-15` imports only stdlib plus `troupe.config.errors`.\n  - `cli/set_command.py:19-28` imports shell names from `troupe.cli.shell` only, never from `main`. The import direction is shell ← set_command ← main.\n  - No `troupe.config.*` module imports `troupe.cli.*`. The only match is a docstring at `writeback/__init__.py:3`.\n  - User files are read only in `loader.py:126,147` (and `locate` only tests for existence).\n  - User files are written only by `writeback/atomic.py:48-71`.\n  - Every name the downstream imports from the foundation is on the Shared Seams list.\n\n### Revalidation Triggers (design.md §Revalidation Triggers)\n- Only one trigger fired: the `SUBCOMMAND_REGISTRARS` entry was added. This is the extension the design planned for ("exactly one entry"), and it was handled: the registration test was updated, and show and history were re-checked above.\n- None of the following fired: changes to seam types, moving names out of `shell`, authority, session lifecycle, storage location or event names, span or decoding semantics, or `load_config` override semantics. No action needed.\n\n### Remaining fields\n- **OWNERSHIP:** LOCAL (no defects found).\n- **UPSTREAM_SPEC:** N/A.\n- **BLOCKED_TASKS:** none. All tasks are `[x]`, and there are no `_Blocked:_` markers.\n- **REMEDIATION:** none required. Optionally, update the test file names in the design.md File Structure Plan to match the actual names.\n\nTemporary theatres were created under `/tmp/tmp.*` (outside the repo). The repository was not changed.
